text.p: Factfile on Spanish international
defender Roberto Rios, bought by Athletic Bilbao from Real Betis
on Saturday for two billion pesetas ($13.5 million):
October 8, 1971 - Born in the Basque city of Bilbao. Father is
former Spanish international Eusebio Rios.
1992 - Signs professional terms with Real Betis.
1996 - After sporadic appearances for Betis, only 11 games
during 1995-96 season and 35 first division games in his career,
suddenly makes huge improvement when moved back to a deeper
role.
October 9, 1996 - Makes international debut. Comes on as
substitute against the Czech Republic. Goes on to win six more
caps before end of season.
June 22, 1997 - Last league game for Real Betis having played
in 36 matches during the 1996-97 season, scoring three times and
being sent off once.
June 28, 1997 - Final game for Betis. On the losing side in the
Spanish Cup final against Barcelona.
July 19, 1997 - Leaves Real Betis for Athletic in his native
city of Bilbao for two billion pesetas ($13.5 million).
